units.bytes: UTF-8 bytes delivered to the task consumer before it names owner/seam/surfaces/preservation
units.operations: every rg search, collector invocation, and source fragment/range read delivered to the consumer
units.activeElapsed: monotonic seconds for those operations; unavailable is null, never zero

allowed: range read only of paths surfaced by that lane's rg result
range read only when the packet's locator is consumed
